comparison.objective: Remove soft items from a crib before a nap, versus commission a rigid industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-item retrieval and clearing, not tool insertion, force control, or feedback-based mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Crib cleared of unsafe soft objects rather than two valid impact cycles with no bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: It tests safety-oriented clearing, not adjustment or dynamic machine behavior.
